locus: Ordo missae (Dominica prima de adventu): quotiescumque; retained facsimile page(s) 2
rights_basis: The underlying 1755 Latin printing is public domain in the United States by expiration of its publication term; publication at Rome in 1755 precedes the pre 1931 boundary applicable in 2026. Mechanical abbreviation expansion and orthographic regularization add no new liturgical composition. Lesley's own notes and line numbers are not transcribed; no modern translation or protected scholarly apparatus is included. The historical text is excluded from Triptych’s CC BY 4.0 licence.
text:
Quotiescumque manducaveritis panem hunc et calicem istum biberitis: mortem Domini annunciabitis donec veniet. In claritatem ✠ de celis.
℟. Chorus. Amen.
